dominant_variable: Whether contracted AI demand converts into shareholder cash flow after depreciation, interest, capex, leases, debt service, and dilution.

lifecycle.note: Public listing created the investable vehicle; financing and customer concentration risks were already material.
Q1 2025 reported revenue growth of 420%, $25.9B revenue backlog, and strong adjusted EBITDA, accelerating market recognition.
Price near $158 reflected substantial multiple expansion; valuation and capital structure became dominant variables.
Q2 2026 confirmed extraordinary demand and scale while debt, leases, interest expense, and capex remained central to equity economics.

decision_state.action: watch_or_start_small; require either improved price asymmetry or further proof of capital conversion before large fundamental sizing
kill_criteria: Backlog or committed demand fails to convert into deployed capacity and recognized revenue on a credible schedule.
Adjusted operating margin stops improving while interest burden remains structurally high.
Debt, lease liabilities, or dilution continue to outgrow the cash-generating capacity of deployed assets.
Customer concentration, financing stress, or contract economics materially weaken the expected return on invested capital.
AI infrastructure supply normalizes enough to compress contract pricing before CoreWeave earns an adequate return on invested capital.

historical_checkpoints.note: Reported figures from Q1 2025 earnings release; backlog remains subject to delivery and service-availability requirements.

Analytical reconstruction using a conservative economic diluted-share convention. Exact values vary with share-count and debt conventions; this checkpoint is an inference, not a company-reported valuation multiple.
Reported Q2 2026 figures. Financial debt equals current and non-current recourse plus non-recourse debt; operating leases are tracked separately rather than relabeled as GAAP debt.

unknowns: Exact contemporaneous full trade record and original thesis of the external investor who entered near $156 are not established from screenshots alone.
A single canonical diluted-share convention for historical valuation must be fixed before production-grade PIT backtests.
The 2025 valuation checkpoint should be independently recomputed from the archived 10-Q/outlook presentation before promotion to decision_grade.

lessons.principle: For capital-intensive hypergrowth, force the bridge from revenue to shareholder FCF through D&A, operating profit, interest, capex, leases/debt, and dilution.
Financing availability is not equivalent to low cost of capital; debt-market access can de-risk execution while still transferring a large share of economics away from equity holders.
A correct business thesis can coexist with a poor entry when valuation multiple expansion has already converted discovery into momentum/expectation risk.
A momentum entry must retain momentum-style exit rules; do not let a failed trend trade drift into an undocumented long-term fundamental position.
